newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Crean expects satisfactory outcome in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Crean expects satisfactory outcome in 1997.

text.p: Irish industrial holding company James Crean Plc said on Tuesday that it expected a satisfactory outcome for 1997.
In a results statement, Crean said frozen meal volumes had continued to grow in its food division and higher operating profits than last year are being achieved at present.

Volumes in its poultry business have been temporarily affected by regional fowl supply constraints but the group expects constraints to be removed over coming months resulting in a greater ability to service rising levels of demand for both canned and individual poultry pieces.

"While demand for industrial electrical products remains flat, leading economic indicators point to a more buoyant market later in the year and the group's electrical division is ideally positioned to benefit from this expected upturn," Crean said.

It said its printing and packaging operations continue to perform satisfactorily and strategic initiatives have been put in place to enable label printing, paper conversion and distribution operations to improve their performance in competitive markets.
